source: ZXNAME0000XZ introduced Multi-head Latent Attention (ZXNAME0001XZ) as a different route to reducing KV-cache cost. Its central idea is to represent the non-positional K/V information through a lower-dimensional latent state. At inference, projection absorption lets the model avoid materializing and caching the full per-head K/V tensors in the conventional way.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 引入了多头潜在注意力（ZXNAME0001XZ）作为降低 KV 缓存成本的不同途径。其中心思想是通过低维潜在状态来表示非位置K/V信息。推理时，投影吸收让模型避免以传统方式具体化和缓存完整的每头 K/V 张量。
